text_block_list.text:
The URA Finals came to a close with 
tremendous success.

The sight of the Umamusume sprinting 
toward glory must have deeply touched the 
hearts of so many people.

Once again, Chairwoman Akikawa also 
offered a passionate cheer alongside her 
deep sense of gratitude...!

Once again, Chairwoman Akikawa also 
expressed her deep sense of gratitude...!
